opening: I've been having episodes where I get confused.
During these episodes I get shaky.
I've had several of these episodes over the past week.
They come in the morning and in the evening, after I've gone several hours without eating.
They go away when I eat something with sugar in it.
I took metformin for my diabetes until recently; it was stopped after the low sugars began.
I have a myoepithelial carcinoma of my left parotid (salivary) gland, and it has spread.

opening.text: I've been having episodes where I get confused, and during these episodes I get shaky. I've had several of these episodes over the past week, and they come in the morning and in the evening, after I've gone several hours without eating. They go away when I eat something with sugar in it. I have type 2 diabetes, and I took metformin for my diabetes until recently; it was stopped after the low sugars began. I also have a myoepithelial carcinoma of my left parotid (salivary) gland, and it has spread.
